exposure: Specific antibody profiles (Anti-beta2 GP-I, ACL, LA, triple positive)
Treatment with low-dose aspirin and low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH)
cohort: Forty-three pregnant women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with primary Antiphospholipid Syndrome were enrolled from a high-risk pregnancy clinic.
finding: Treatment for pregnant women with Antiphospholipid Syndrome significantly improved the live birth rate, though preeclampsia, fetal growth restriction, and preterm birth remained challenging late pregnancy complications despite treatment, with certain antibody profiles (Anti-beta2 GP-I and ACL positivity) linked to fewer adverse pregnancy outcomes.
